latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — free and easy YouTube-to-TikTok video conversion.

- Instantly convert YouTube or uploaded video clips (MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI, up to 500MB) into TikTok-ready, captioned clips.
- Automatically applies vertical 9:16 crop and outputs high-quality 1080p MP4.
- Simple workflow: upload/URL, describe your edit (e.g., “cut into short TikTok clips with captions”), and download your result.
- No software or account needed; free credits provided with anonymous token (valid for 7 days).
- Seamlessly handles credits, status, export, and common error conditions.
